title: Chapter 381
content:
Chapter 381

The formation itself is connected to the ground veins, plus 50,000 soldiers as a link to communicate with each other, forming a powerful domain force.

Among them, the power of the connection's ground veins is more important, and it plays most of the power for transportation.

But many people don't know that apart from absorbing the power from punishing the Goulian Leyline, there is another very useful change.

That is to change the direction of the earth veins, and even directly detonate the earth energy of the earth veins, triggering the change of the entire terrain to run wild.

If this force is directly triggered, it will be the most powerful and even able to smash the entire Kanto region into pieces, sink directly to the bottom of the sea, and completely disappear in the entire Japanese world.

And after the detonation of the local qi, even with the status of the Dao of Heaven in this world, it is difficult to recover, and I can only watch helplessly as a piece of my body disappears.

This method is not only about killing living beings, but also obtaining the luck stored in them.

Instead, they directly obtained the luck in their bodies from Tiandi's body.

Although there is a lot of luck stored in the bodies of all the creatures in a world, it is far from the accumulation of countless years in a world.

The luck gained by killing creatures is not comparable to the luck gained by destroying the world.

Just like Zhong Yu's first world, the Three Kingdoms world.

Even if it has caused a huge impact in the whole world, the population of the whole world has been reduced by more than half, and it has gained a huge amount of luck.

However, the sum of these lucks is not as good as the luck he obtained by directly destroying the entire world. The gap is more than ten times larger. From this we can see the gap, and the benefits gained by the two actions are different.

But now, Zhong Yu's purpose is to detonate it with the power of this incomparably thick ground vein, and completely destroy the entire Kanto region.

Coupled with Zhong Yu's arrangement in the territory of the original eight countries in the Dojo, all 16 countries in the Kanto and Northeast of Japan will sink the land.

What kind of achievement is this?

Presumably, the harvested luck should be quite a lot. Judging from the scale of this world, there should be 20 to 30 million luck.

Even more, not impossible.

With such a huge luck, it is more than enough to repair Zhong Yu's injury, and it is not impossible to break through the seventh level in one fell swoop with this foundation.

And after breaking through to the seventh level, there should be enough luck left, enough to go on an interstellar journey again, across countless worlds, and find a world that allows him to break through to the level of a fairy.

"It's finally here, let me end it all!"

With a roar, Zhong Yu erupted thousands of purple energy all over his body, exuding an extremely terrifying aura, and the surrounding energy surged rapidly, and the power of the formation that sacrificed 50,000 soldiers all gathered towards him.

Within the territory of the Eight Kingdoms of Kanto, mysterious runes emerged one by one, connected in series with each other, forming a mysterious formation.

Within the formation, blood light and purple appeared, intertwined with each other, and flowed rapidly along specific trajectories. As they flowed, the power of the formation became more and more vigorous.

"Blast me!"

Pressing the ground with both hands, a strong force of terror quickly spread, along the direction of the ground veins, flowing to all the underground in the Eight Kingdoms.

And with the rapid movement of time, it has already broken through the territory of the Eight Kingdoms, and began to turn to the original territory of the dojo.

Finally, in less than ten minutes, finally, the power gushing out of the body has penetrated the 16 countries, corroding all the underground veins under them.

click.

After more than ten minutes of resistance, the protection above the head finally couldn't hold up. Under the bombardment of several thunderbolts, more and more cracks appeared on the mask formed by the formation, spreading to all corners.

Finally, during the fifth attack, the mask cracked and shattered.

"Heh! Let me just say, how can he resist the might of heaven and earth with his strength at the same level as ours, now without the protection of this formation, let me see how he can resist the next tribulation thunder!"

God Amaterasu sneered, looking down at Zhong Yu who had been completely revealed in their eyes, the endless fog had completely disappeared under the bombardment of Jielei, and now they could clearly see all the current situations in the Eight Kingdoms.

However, the current situation of the eight countries made them feel extremely angry.

I saw that the population below was densely populated, and there were more than 2 million territories of the eight countries. The towns and cities were prosperous and everywhere.

But now, in just over two hours, there are ruins everywhere, and the city that has not been completely burned is still emitting thick smoke. The corpses on the ground were scattered everywhere, and no one went to restrain them.

There were very few living creatures that could be seen everywhere, but now there were very few, and the rest hid in some remote and safe places to linger and dare not come out.

According to their estimates, after this catastrophe, it is not bad if there are 500,000 people left in the territories of the eight countries.

In addition to the dojo territory they explored before, all living people were sacrificed, and there was not a single living person anywhere they passed.

The entire Northeast and Kanto regions, plus a part of the central region, turned into ghosts.

Such a huge population loss, even if they are high gods, they are horrified and even more angry.

This is not tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of people, but a total of three to four million, which is almost equivalent to 1/3 of Japan's land!

The people in these places are all dead, and it will take a lot of time to recover later, especially the gap in population, it is even more difficult to make up for it.

It is estimated that in the next hundred years, the entire east of the central part of Honshu Island will fall into barrenness, and it will require the slow development and construction of later generations to restore the prosperity of the past.

Of course, these are not the real reasons for their anger, aren't they just some people? Their lifespan is infinite, and there is plenty of time to wait until enough people fill these lands.

What they are afraid of and angry about is the resentment after so many people die.

The resentment of the death of millions of people is an extremely terrifying force. Although it will not destroy the world, it can still be done by moving mountains and reclamation.

Especially these people, as the Taoist gods believed by more than 4 million people, did not give the slightest help when so many believers perished, and allowed them to be killed.

Among so many resentments, a considerable part must be directed towards them.

When these resentments are separated, although they will not be swallowed up all at once, they will linger for a long time. During this period, it is possible for the cultivation base to decline, the body to be cursed and weak, or even fall to the current realm.

That's enough to make them terrified and terrified.
